findings.title: <html> without lang
findings.fix: Set <html lang="zh-Hant-TW"> or the right language.

findings.title: No responsive viewport meta
findings.fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.

findings.message: font stack is only ""Inter", system-ui, sans-serif"
findings.title: Inter (or system-ui) is the only typeface
findings.fix: Pick a display or text face that fits the product, and keep Inter only as a fallback if at all.

findings.message: page contains CJK text but no font-family lists a CJK face
findings.title: CJK text with no CJK font in the stack
findings.fix: Add "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC" before the generic family.

findings.title: CJK body line-height under 1.5
findings.fix: Use line-height 1.6–1.8 for zh-TW paragraphs.

findings.title: height: 100vh
findings.fix: Use 100dvh (with 100vh fallback) or min-height.

findings.title: Purple→blue / violet→pink gradient
findings.fix: Use a flat brand color, a gradient within one hue family, or real imagery.

findings.message: font-style: italic on ".hero h1" in a CJK document
findings.title: Italic applied to CJK text
findings.fix: Emphasise CJK with weight, color, or 着重號 (text-emphasis) instead.

findings.title: Text contrast below WCAG AA
findings.fix: Darken/lighten the text or background until the ratio reaches 4.5:1.

findings.message: outline: none on ".btn" and no :focus-visible style in file
findings.title: Focus outline removed without replacement
findings.fix: Keep outline, or provide a clear :focus-visible style.

findings.title: transition: all
findings.fix: List the properties: transition: opacity .2s, transform .2s.

findings.title: Button padding ≤4px
findings.fix: Use at least 8px vertical / 12–16px horizontal padding.

findings.title: Animation without prefers-reduced-motion
findings.fix: Wrap non-essential animation in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference).

findings.title: Large fixed pixel width
findings.fix: Use max-width with width:100%, or fluid units / grid.

findings.title: Purple→blue / violet→pink gradient
findings.fix: Use a flat brand color, a gradient within one hue family, or real imagery.

findings.title: Font size below 12px
findings.fix: Use ≥14px for body, ≥12px for captions; CJK body text ≥15px.

findings.message: emoji in <h1>: "🚀 Unlock the power of 智慧筆記"
findings.title: Emoji used as UI icons
findings.fix: Use an SVG icon set with a consistent stroke, plus a text label or tooltip.

findings.title: Hype marketing filler
findings.fix: State the concrete outcome, number, or feature instead.

findings.title: Emoji used as UI icons
findings.fix: Use an SVG icon set with a consistent stroke, plus a text label or tooltip.

findings.title: Form control without a label
findings.fix: Wrap in <label>, link with for/id, or add aria-label.

findings.title: Icon tile above every heading
findings.fix: Vary the layout, use real screenshots/numbers, or drop the decorative icons.

findings.title: Skipped heading level
findings.fix: Use consecutive levels; style with CSS, not by picking a smaller tag.

findings.title: Card inside a card
findings.fix: Flatten: keep the outer container and turn the inner one into a plain section, list row or divider.

findings.title: Image without alt
findings.fix: Add alt text, or alt="" for purely decorative images.

findings.title: Image without width/height
findings.fix: Set width/height attributes or aspect-ratio.

findings.message: export component MainWindow inherits Window has no min-width/min-height
findings.title: Window without min-width/min-height
findings.fix: Set min-width/min-height (or a root layout with min sizes) on the Window.

findings.message: Window has CJK text but no default-font-family
findings.title: Window without default-font-family (CJK app)
findings.fix: Set default-font-family: "Microsoft JhengHei UI" on the Window (and bundle/declare fallbacks).

findings.title: Purple→blue / violet→pink gradient
findings.fix: Use a flat brand color, a gradient within one hue family, or real imagery.

findings.message: font-italic: true in a file with CJK text
findings.title: Italic applied to CJK text
findings.fix: Emphasise CJK with weight, color, or 着重號 (text-emphasis) instead.

findings.message: emoji in text: "🚀 超快下載器"
findings.title: Emoji used as UI icons
findings.fix: Use an SVG icon set with a consistent stroke, plus a text label or tooltip.

findings.message: Button with icon and no text/tooltip
findings.title: Icon-only button without tooltip/name
findings.fix: Show a tooltip on hover (TouchArea has-hover) and set accessible-label.

findings.message: Button with icon and no text/tooltip
findings.title: Icon-only button without tooltip/name
findings.fix: Show a tooltip on hover (TouchArea has-hover) and set accessible-label.

findings.message: Button with icon and no text/tooltip
findings.title: Icon-only button without tooltip/name
findings.fix: Show a tooltip on hover (TouchArea has-hover) and set accessible-label.

findings.title: Font size below 12px
findings.fix: Use ≥14px for body, ≥12px for captions; CJK body text ≥15px.

findings.title: Text contrast below WCAG AA
findings.fix: Darken/lighten the text or background until the ratio reaches 4.5:1.
